purpose.name: Golftrip
purpose.text: Golftrip mit einem Freund: jeden Tag eine Runde, an einem Tag 36 Loch. Plätze nicht zu bergig. An- und Abreisetag sind Golftage.
constraints: golf every day, 36 holes on one day
central base, all courses within 1 h drive
arrival day: early flight, then golf near airport, then check-in
departure day: golf near airport, then flight

hard: flights only from verified schedule data; FRA→AGP direct (LH) present for March
a golf round on each of the 5 days, one day with two rounds
day 1 and day 5 courses within ~40 min of AGP
no course more than 60 min from the base except on travel days
weather block shows March climate for Málaga
soft: items carry status (option/booked/rejected) and price per person

$itemsComment: Trip items (timed-items spec): a booked arrival flight (the later verified LH flight, so it overrides the schedule heuristic), a booked dinner, and an option that must stay out of the plan.
